numeric.note: Pinned BEFORE seeing any replay output (thread model-results-improvement-20261008, GPT file 26 mục 2.7). Row passes iff abs(replay - saved) <= atol_vnd + rtol * abs(saved). No CLI override; changing it requires a new replay-config version argued from hypothesis/evidence, never after results.

runtime.note: Default mode requires the replay runtime to equal the versions recorded in the run report (environment.actual) before any joblib.load; a mismatch fails (exit 4) unless --compat-probe is given explicitly, which can never be labelled exact-runtime PASS.

train_in_sample.note: Separate declared verdict; recomputes TRAIN in-sample aggregates from the bundles and compares with the report. Not mixed with the validation/test row-level verdict.
